title: Sales stay with the customer the work was for
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Make sure customer A and customer B have no other sales today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced today for $95.50, that bills itself, unpaid.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 3, for customer A, invoiced today for $40.00, that bills itself, unpaid.
custom_steps: 1. Open the Sales By Customer report for today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's sales read $250.00 ($210.00 for work order 1 + $40.00 for work order 3).
  • Customer B's sales read $95.50 (work order 2 only): the $210.00 it owes for customer A's work is not counted as its sales.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289

  • Key Decisions: “ShopView's own reports still credit the work to the customer.”
  • Out of Scope: “Report columns for Bill To (Bill To on sales, margin and technician reports; service customer on A/R Aging, statements, Customer Transactions): follow-up with Report Modernization. Until then, sales reports name the customer the work was for.”
  • Goals: “The truck's history, pricing and revenue stay with the customer the work was for on every invoice billed to someone else.”
  • Key Decisions: “Two customers, split by job. The customer owns pricing, tax, discounts, fees, shop supplies, history and revenue; the Bill To owns the receivable, terms, credit limit, Credit Hold, PO, deposits, payments, QuickBooks customer and IBS.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The customer keeps the truck, the service history, pricing, tax, discounts, fees, shop supplies and the revenue.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
